rationale: All 3 fix-set findings verified against HEAD source and resolved; OverviewView passes no pagination props so it is unaffected by the RepositoriesTable change. CR-003 was resolved by documenting why the filter is not passed (the tab never sets the prop), as the recommendation allowed.

findings.title: Single-page repositories list shows pagination
findings.problem: Spec Behavior 6 requires pagination hidden when there is one page. RepositoriesTable renders Pagination whenever page props are given (RepositoriesTable.tsx:202) with no totalPages > 1 guard. The hook's setPage ignores perPage, so the per-page selector also has no effect.
findings.impact: Users see pagination and a non-functional per-page selector on every repositories list, including single-page ones; required spec behavior partially unmet.
findings.recommendation: Hide pagination when totalPages <= 1 and do not offer a per-page selector that setPage ignores.
findings.check_notes: RepositoriesTable showPagination now requires totalPages > 1; per-page selector and perPageOptions removed. OverviewView passes no page props, so unaffected.

fix.change: RepositoriesTable hides pagination when totalPages<=1 and drops the ineffective per-page selector

findings.title: Tab description still mentions repositories
findings.problem: Spec Behavior 1 says the description no longer mentions repositories or branches, but it reads 'Click a project to view its repositories and sessions.'
findings.impact: Required spec behavior partially unmet; text is misleading about the tab's contents.
findings.recommendation: Reword the description so it no longer mentions repositories or branches.
findings.check_notes: RepositoriesView description now reads 'Click a project to view its details.'

fix.change: Tab description reworded to 'Click a project to view its details.'

findings.title: Repositories filter not passed to modal lists
findings.problem: RepositoriesView passes the repositories prop to useCliAnalyticsProjects but not to ProjectRepositoriesList or the repositories and branches hooks.
findings.impact: When the repositories filter is active, the project row figures and the modal lists can describe different sets. Reachability of the filter into this view was unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: If the backend contract applies the repositories filter to these requests, pass it through ProjectRepositoriesList and both hooks; otherwise document why not.
findings.check_notes: Comment documents that the repositories prop narrows project rows only and the tab never sets it; recommendation allowed documenting why not.

fix.change: Documented in RepositoriesView that the repositories prop narrows project rows only; the tab never sets it and the modal lists are project-scoped (no backend contract for passing it)

findings.title: Stale branches slot may flash on reopen
findings.problem: The store slot keeps the prior repository's data with loading false until the fetch effect runs.
findings.impact: One frame of the previous repository's branches may show; self-corrects once loading is set.
findings.recommendation: Clear the slot on unmount or on fetch start in render.

findings.title: Empty state shown alongside error
findings.problem: isEmpty is true when an error leaves rows empty, so 'No branch data available' appears with the error.
findings.impact: Mildly confusing message on a failed request; the error is still shown.

findings.title: Null branch used as table id
findings.problem: idPath='branch' and selection matching on branch; the unattributed row has a null branch.
findings.impact: Only one null row exists per list, so the trigger is narrow; reselecting after close could be ambiguous.
findings.recommendation: Key rows by branch ?? a sentinel.
